basis: each text read whole BEFORE any extractor was run on it and after the instruction was fixed; phrases in which the text says who or what lives there. core: decides how the inhabitant stands to the place, or is the text's own answer

4250.anchor: Humanoid beings, with skin that subtly shifts in hue
Animals, though not as abundant as the plant life, exist in equally fascinating varieties.
The beings here seek not to overcome or dominate their environment, but to become an integral part of it

5487.anchor: the inhabitants are a strange and enigmatic mix of the natural and the surreal
The bat-like creatures, known as the *Noctilum*, are the most prominent
they are the eyes and ears of the plateau
The smaller, furry mammals, known as the *Crepuscule*, are a vital part of the plateau's food chain
The Crepuscule are not just prey; they are also scavengers
The Umbral Stalkers are apex predators
is not just a backdrop; it is a living, breathing part of the plateau's ecosystem
These constructs, known as the *Mechanoids*, are a blend of organic and inorganic materials
They seem to be caretakers of some kind

25577.anchor: The dwellers do not arrive so much as condense.
At first they are only the heat itself taking slower shapes
The body is a low, ambulatory hollow.
They are many, yet the eye never quite manages a census.
The city dreams through them; they house the city in turn.
the distinction between inhabitant and place thins to a membrane
Their slow pouring locomotion is only the clay remembering forward.
What lives here is the courtyard’s unfinished thought given temporary skins of heat and patience.
It has no name that would survive translation onto harder lands.

26526.anchor: The local people call it the *stone that walks*.
They are the most ordinary thing in the place.
are not birds the way other birds are birds
The plants are not animals, but several of them behave as if they have not been informed.
Some things in the saddle are not, strictly, in the saddle. They are the saddle.
It is a thing that has been *stopped*.
There is no one inside the prism. There is also no *not-one*.
It is a place that *is* life
They are not residents of the saddle.
They are the saddle's slow articulation
The lizards. The beetles. The crane flies.
This is not the same as saying something lives in it.
The lizard has no name in the local herpetology guides.

15603.anchor: The settlement’s human inhabitants appear stocky and taut
They’ve come to resemble the land they occupy, these people and creatures
called by various local names that each generation reinvents
these people are less distinct from the environment than their animal counterparts
no single life form dominates; instead, all are woven together in quiet symbiosis
The final form of their land has become their final form as well
pulses of life beating within the canyon’s timeless heart

10719.anchor: They do not arrive. They emerge from the gradient.
They do not command the settlement.
There is no hierarchy. There are specializations
A child is not born; it is braided.
They are not the masters of this place. They are its syntax.
They do not live in the settlement. They are the settlement's continuous verb.
they are the grammar that keeps it coherent

24208.anchor: Those who live in the basin do not regard the city as being full of animals.
as strange as dividing a body into citizen and organs
The hand-sized shoals in the lower streets are traffic, sanitation, weather, and food.
The conventional inhabitants are only the most concentrated knots in this civic life.
There are disputes over whether those species are possessions, relatives, or citizens.
An adult is a central body, a coat colony
Names are chords of these recognitions.
The building is consequently counted among the child’s progenitors.
One may have three mobile parents, a tower, a swarm, and a section of municipal field.
the Hollow is the city’s true inhabitant and all other life merely its temporary sensory layer

2791.anchor: What lives there is not a creature
The inhabitants are the mineral plants
The two have become one habitat, one metabolism
They are not parasitic on the machines in any simple sense.
There is no individual sovereign among them, but there are older presences.
So what lives there is a consortium
It is a body only because every part has learned the use of every other part.
Living as a hum made visible.

12810.anchor: The ones who live here call themselves the Listeners
They are not the only intelligent life here, though they are the only one that builds.
They share the cavern with the spine-crawlers, vast centipedal beings
we are the listening that the world does to itself
they are a harmonic within that wave

24739.anchor: They are something that stopped trying to be a tree.
It is not thinking. But it is attending.
They are hermits who chose the exact distance
The Flute Flies are the air.
The custodians of distance are the Salt Wasps.
there are things that have forgotten they are animals
You are part of the fauna that forgot it was animal.
you have named it North without meaning to
The ribbon things that are not snakes and not birds
